info.title: Scalar Galaxy
info.description:
The Scalar Galaxy is an example OpenAPI specification to test OpenAPI tools and libraries. It’s a fictional universe with fictional planets and fictional data. Get all the data for [all planets](#tag/planets/GET/planets). ## Resources * https://github.com/scalar/scalar * https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification * https://scalar.com ## Markdown Support All descriptions *can* contain ~~tons of text~~ **Markdown**. [If GitHub supports the syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/getting-started-with-writing-and-formatting-on-github/basic-writing-and-formatting-syntax), chances are we’re supporting it, too. You can even create [internal links to reference endpoints](#tag/authentication/POST/user/signup).
Examples **Blockquotes** > I love OpenAPI. <3 **Tables** | Feature | Availability | | ---------------- | ------------ | | Markdown Support | ✓ | **Accordion** ```html

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Some endpoints are public, but some require authentication. We provide all the required endpoints to create an account and authorize yourself.

get.description: It’s easy to say you know them all, but do you really? Retrieve all the planets and check whether you missed one.

with ScalarPythonSDK() as sps_client:

    res = sps_client.planets.upload_image(planet_id=1, image={
        "file_name": "example.file",
        "content": open("example.file", "rb"),

    # Handle response

require 'scalar_ruby_sdk'

  image: Models::Operations::Image.new(
    file_name: 'example.file',
    content: "0x0c92e741F1".encode(),
  ),
))

if ! res.image_uploaded_message.nil?
  # handle response
end
